**The best move is Rxe1** (Black's rook from e8 captures White's rook on e1).

This wins White's rook outright. The rook on d7 cannot recapture since it can only move along the d-file and 7th rank. After this, Black has won a full rook and the game is decided.

**Coaching note:** Notice that White's rook on e1 is undefended and vulnerable to your back-rank rook. Before placing pieces on advanced squares like d7, check if they're protected or if your opponent can win them. Here, the rook had no defender, making it a free capture. Always look for undefended pieces, especially when your rooks control open files.
